originBody.name: Abyssal
originBody.description: A creature of the deep — armored, swift in water, and able to call guardian allies. Slow and dries out on land.

originBody.name: Air Mage
originBody.description: A swift aeromancer who hurls wind charges, spins a whirlwind of displacement, and rides updrafts into the sky. Light as a breeze, but frail as a leaf.

originBody.name: Arachnid
originBody.description: Nimble spider-folk who scale any wall, fling webs at foes, and strike with fangs — kin to the eight-legged crawlers of the world.

originBody.name: Archer
originBody.description: A ranged specialist with perfect aim and nimble footwork.

originBody.name: Asura
originBody.description: A frail-bodied berserker who grows faster and stronger the closer death looms. Fragile when whole, monstrous when bleeding. As the fury deepens it learns to feed itself: draining life from every blow it lands, refusing to fall while it still rages, and at last erupting in a blast of raw wrath.

originBody.name: Automaton
originBody.description: A mechanical construct that never drowns or starves — but healing potions fizzle, natural recovery is glacial, and every step is heavy.

originBody.name: Avian
originBody.description: A graceful flier who drifts down slowly, fears no heights, and watches the world from above.

originBody.name: Beastmaster
originBody.description: An animal tamer whose pets share your potion effects and whose potions last longer.

originBody.name: Berserker
originBody.description: A frenzied fighter who trades hunger for devastating raw power.

originBody.name: Blacksmith
originBody.description: A master crafter whose equipment is higher quality and whose repairs are more efficient.

originBody.name: Blazeling
originBody.description: Born of the nether fires — scaled in brimstone, restored in the dark realm, but poisoned by water and rain.

originBody.name: Breeze
originBody.description: A creature of wind born in the Trial Chambers — fast, airborne, and armed with gusts, but light and fragile.

originBody.name: Cave Dragon
originBody.description: A dragon of fire and stone, born deep beneath the world. Thrives in heat and darkness, and grows into its full power over time.

originBody.name: Caveborn
originBody.description: Raised in the deep dark — eats raw stone, chews through ore with bare hands, but withers in sunlight.

originBody.name: Cinderborn
originBody.description: A volcanic fire elemental — immune to flame, terrifying to beasts, and healed by lava — but devastated by water.

originBody.name: Cleric
originBody.description: A holy scholar with enhanced enchanting abilities and extended potion durations.

originBody.name: Cook
originBody.description: A culinary expert whose crafted food is more nourishing and who gains bonus XP from smoking.

originBody.name: Darkness Mage
originBody.description: A shadow-weaving sorcerer who summons orbiting shadow orbs and steps between pools of darkness. Cloaked and deadly at night, but sunlight burns away your power.

originBody.name: Draconic
originBody.description: Dragon-blooded and fearsome — immune to fire and terrifying to beasts, but the draconic flame burns through stamina fast.

originBody.name: Dwarf
originBody.description: A stout underground craftsman — compact, armored, and tireless at the forge, but short-limbed and slow on the surface.

originBody.name: Earth Mage
originBody.description: A stalwart geomancer who slams the ground to rupture foes and raises stone walls at a gesture. Immovable as a mountain, but the earth holds them close — water and heights are not their friends.

originBody.name: Elytrian
originBody.description: A pure flight specialist — soars through the skies, untouched by kinetic forces, but fragile of frame and incapable of bearing heavy armor.

originBody.name: Enderian
originBody.description: Born on the outer islands of the End — teleports at will, dodges projectiles into the void, and walks unseen by endermen. Water burns like acid.

originBody.name: Enderite
originBody.description: A being born of the End — master of teleportation and phasing, graceful in descent, but vulnerable to water and daylight.

originBody.name: Explorer
originBody.description: A seasoned traveler who starts equipped for adventure and rarely tires.

originBody.name: Feline
originBody.description: A quick cat-person with keen night vision and a pouncing leap — lands on their feet, slips past wolves and ocelots, but loathes water and burns through energy fast.

originBody.name: Fire Mage
originBody.description: A volatile pyromancer wreathed in flame — hurls fireballs, bursts into an inferno, and burns those who strike you. Fire cannot harm you, but water is your undoing.

originBody.name: Fisher
originBody.description: Life at the water's edge — draws luck from the tides, swims like a seal, and starts with a blessed rod.

originBody.name: Forest Dragon
originBody.description: A dragon of root and thorn, at home among ancient trees. Patient and resilient, it grows stronger as it matures.

originBody.name: Frostborn
originBody.description: An elemental of ice and cold — freezes enemies, thrives in taigas, but fire and the Nether are devastating.

originBody.name: Golden Body
originBody.description: A hard-qigong master of the Iron Body arts. An armored, immovable wall that punishes anyone who strikes it, at the cost of nimbleness. Tempered further it becomes the Diamond Body: harder still to wound, hurling back twice the force of every blow, and ringing out a toll that leaves all nearby attackers slowed and weakened.

originBody.name: Golem
originBody.description: A walking fortress of iron and will — nearly immovable, but slow and vulnerable to heat.

originBody.name: Gorgon
originBody.description: A stone-skinned monstrosity whose gaze petrifies and whose fists shatter — but the weight of stone slows every step.

originBody.name: Gravity Mage
originBody.description: A warper of gravitational fields who bends space itself. Pull enemies into a crushing singularity or blast them away — but your own body is untethered from the earth.

originBody.name: Herbalist
originBody.description: A green thumb who accelerates crop growth, harvests bonus yields, and resists poison.

originBody.name: Hiveling
originBody.description: A bee-like insectoid who flies freely, stings foes with a venomous strike, and coaxes crops to grow. Fragile wings and endless hunger are the price of flight.

originBody.name: Human
originBody.description: A regular human being, with no special powers but well-rounded abilities.

originBody.name: Inchling
originBody.description: A quarter-sized humanoid who scales walls with ease and moves with surprising speed — but a fragile body comes with the territory.

originBody.name: Iron Monk
originBody.description: A defender monk whose every art draws on one pool of stamina. Raise your guard to shrug off blows, but block and strike both burn the same reserve, and an exhausted Iron Monk is wide open. With training the stance turns the fight: blows rebound on the attacker, stamina trickles back even mid-guard, and the Lohan Palm clears everything around you.

originBody.name: Kraken
originBody.description: A colossal deep-sea predator born in the open ocean — devastating underwater with tentacle lashes, ink shots, and summoned guardians, but beached, sun-burned, and dried out on the surface.

originBody.name: Lumberjack
originBody.description: A master woodsman who fells entire trees with one swing and crafts extra planks from logs.

originBody.name: Mason
originBody.description: Stone yields to practiced hands — breaks blocks faster, callused palms armor the body, and a pick is always within reach.

originBody.name: Merchant
originBody.description: A shrewd trader whose villager trades never run out and who finds rare goods from wandering traders.

originBody.name: Merling
originBody.description: An aquatic people born in the open ocean — breathes water and swims with ease, but slow and dries out on dry land.

originBody.name: Miner
originBody.description: An expert excavator who breaks blocks faster and mines without tiring.

originBody.name: Monster Tamer
originBody.description: A fearless beast handler who bends hostile mobs to their will. Alone they are frail, but with a loyal pack at their side, they are a force to be reckoned with.

originBody.name: Necromancer
originBody.description: A master of death who commands undead minions — wither skeletons and archers fight at your side, but your own life force is bound to theirs.

originBody.name: Nitwit
originBody.description: Not particularly good at anything. Sometimes the simplest path is the right one.

originBody.name: Paladin
originBody.description: A holy warrior — undead falter at a touch, wither cannot take hold, and the light of a beacon heals wounds.

originBody.name: Phantom
originBody.description: A spectral being — gliding through the night on elytra wings, drawing strength from kills, but burned by sunlight and unable to rest.

originBody.name: Piglin
originBody.description: A gold-obsessed Nether warrior — powerful at home, feared by kin, but weakened outside the Nether.

originBody.name: Qi Cultivator
originBody.description: A practitioner of inner arts who channels Qi into ranged palm-strikes and hardened flesh. Meditate to refill your reserves, but a cultivator run dry is just a monk. As the dantian widens, Qi circulates even mid-fight, a brimming core lends real weight to every strike, and the highest art looses a flying sword of pure energy.

originBody.name: Revenant
originBody.description: An undead wanderer who phases through matter and hurls bolts of withering rot — cannot drown and sees in darkness, but heals slowly and burns in sunlight.

originBody.name: Rogue
originBody.description: A stealthy assassin who turns invisible while sneaking and deals devastating backstab damage.

originBody.name: Scout
originBody.description: A keen-eyed pathfinder with night vision, swift movement, and sure footing.

originBody.name: Sculkborn
originBody.description: A being of the deep dark — armored, resistant, and armed with sonic power — but slow, frail in sunlight, and weakened above ground.

originBody.name: Sea Dragon
originBody.description: A dragon of tide and storm, born to the open water. Swift beneath the waves, it comes into its full strength with age.

originBody.name: Sentinel
originBody.description: A defensive specialist with natural armor, thorns, and unshakeable footing.

originBody.name: Shulk
originBody.description: Armored like a shulker — shrugs off blows, retreats into a shell when cornered, and launches foes skyward with a levitation burst. Slow, but unshakeable.

originBody.name: Siren
originBody.description: An aquatic enchantress born in the open ocean — charms creatures with an alluring presence and heals in the tides, but frail, slow, and dries out on land.

originBody.name: Skeleton
originBody.description: A reanimated bag of bones — fast, light, and deadly with a bow. Fragile frame, shunned by the sun, and only able to stomach the foulest morsels.

originBody.name: Slime
originBody.description: A gelatinous being that must stay hydrated to survive. Bounces harmlessly off falls, splits away from death when well-moistened, and grows tougher with experience.

originBody.name: Sporeling
originBody.description: A fungal creature that thrives in darkness and mushroom fields — armed with toxic spores, but withered by sunlight.

originBody.name: Stoneguard
originBody.description: Born of living stone — an unshakeable sentinel who sheds thorns onto attackers, mines rock with bare hands, and sets glowstone torches into the dark. Slow, but unmoving ground never leaves them.

originBody.name: Strider
originBody.description: A Nether-native creature that walks on lava and heals in its warmth — but the cold overworld and water are crippling.

originBody.name: Sword Immortal
originBody.description: A sword immortal who flies on their blade, hurls sword-qi at range and blinks through battle. Every signature art is bound to the sword in hand: disarmed, you fall back to a fall-immune mortal. As blade and heart become one, your edge bites deeper, a heavenly formation rains swords around you, and a single gathered slash can all but sever the sky.

originBody.name: Sylvan
originBody.description: A spirit of the old forest — swift among the trees, loved by wildlife, and able to entangle foes with a surge of roots. Healed by rain, but scorched by the Nether.

originBody.name: Tiny
originBody.description: Small in stature but quick and nimble — climbs anything, pulls in items, but hits like a feather.

originBody.name: Titan
originBody.description: A towering brute with extra health, extended reach, and imposing stature.

originBody.name: Umbral
originBody.description: A child of shadow — hurls orbs of dark energy, dashes between positions, and deflects arrows. Swift in the dark, burned by sunlight.

originBody.name: Vampire
originBody.description: An undead predator of the night — swift, strong, and eternally hungry. Sunlight is agony, water burns, and only raw flesh sustains you.

originBody.name: Verdant
originBody.description: A living embodiment of the green world — tireless, at peace with the wild, but utterly destroyed by the Nether's corruption.

originBody.name: Voidwalker
originBody.description: A being touched by the End — phases through blocks, blinks short distances, and walks unseen by most threats. Sprints without tiring, but water is agony.

originBody.name: Warden
originBody.description: Born from the deep dark — senses the world through vibrations, unleashes a sonic boom at range, and hits like a battering ram. Lumbering and pained by sunlight.

originBody.name: Warrior
originBody.description: A combat specialist who hits harder and stands firm against knockback.

originBody.name: Water Mage
originBody.description: A fluid caster who wields tides and healing currents. At home in the ocean, but withers in arid wastelands.

originBody.name: Windwalker
originBody.description: A master of qinggong, the art of weightlessness. Steps off the air, scales sheer walls, dashes on the wind and never fears a fall, but carries no extra strength into a fight. As mastery grows the sky opens further: gliding freely on the breeze, then walking on air at will, and finally calling down a cyclone far greater than the Typhoon.

originBody.name: Wraith
originBody.description: A tormented spirit that drifts through solid matter. Phases through most blocks but cannot pass obsidian until it reaches its apex form. Sustaining a physical form drains hunger, and sunlight sears its spectral flesh.
